paper.title: Fast leave-one-cluster-out cross-validation using clustered network information criterion

evidence.paraphrase: The title identifies leave-one-cluster-out cross-validation and a criterion designed around clustered observations.
The method replaces an independence-based information estimate with a clustering-adjusted estimator and is evaluated against cluster-based cross-validation.

reviews.rationale: The paper directly addresses validation when observations are clustered and therefore not adequately represented by an i.i.d. validation assumption. Its cluster-adjusted approximation to leave-one-cluster-out validation supports the dependent-inference role from the abstract alone.

paper.title: Error processing and gender-shared and -specific neural predictors of relapse in cocaine dependence

evidence.paraphrase: The study uses resampling only to validate neuroimaging predictors of cocaine relapse; it does not analyze dependence among resampled evaluation units.

reviews.rationale: The occurrence of data resampling is incidental to a clinical prediction study. The abstract supplies no method or inference correction for correlated folds, repeated resamples, clustered units, or dependent perturbations.

paper.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Early Assessment of COVID-19 Risk Prediction in Emergency Departments

evidence.paraphrase: The paper applies ordinary 10-fold cross-validation for variable selection in COVID-19 risk prediction without identifying or correcting dependence among folds or observations.

reviews.rationale: Using cross-validation does not by itself support the dependent-inference role. The abstract presents a clinical prediction workflow and gives no dependent-resampling, clustered, or repeated-measures inference method.

paper.title: Importance of regional variation in conservation planning: a rangewide example of the Greater Sage‐Grouse

evidence.paraphrase: Cross-validation is reported as a model-performance statistic, while clustering refers to spatial concentration of bird abundance rather than dependence-aware resampling inference.

reviews.rationale: The apparent match comes from unrelated uses of cross-validation and clustering in ecological habitat modeling. The abstract does not contribute a method for valid inference under dependent folds, resamples, topics, or perturbations.

paper.title: An Evolutionary-Network Model Reveals Stratified Interactions in the V3 Loop of the HIV-1 Envelope

evidence.paraphrase: The method models substitutions on phylogenetic branches and uses a parametric bootstrap for uncertainty in ancestral substitution mapping, not dependence among repeated evaluation samples.

reviews.rationale: Although the study accounts for evolutionary history and uses a bootstrap, its target is residue interaction detection in HIV sequences. It does not address inference from correlated folds, repeated resampling, clustered evaluation units, or corpus perturbations in the specified role.
